model: Claude Code agent mode, fresh subagent

steps.start: the intersection of the 250 m contour line to the west of the Sweltzer River and the southerly boundary of the District of Chilliwack
steps.quote: Commencing at the intersection of the 250 m contour line to the west of the Sweltzer River and the southerly boundary of the District of Chilliwack

steps.until: its intersection with the northern boundary of the Cultus Lake Provincial Park
steps.quote: thence following the contour line southerly and westerly to its intersection with the northern boundary of the Cultus Lake Provincial Park

steps.until: its southwestern corner and its intersection with the 100 m contour line
steps.quote: thence easterly, southerly and southeasterly following the boundary to its southwestern corner and its intersection with the 100 m contour line
thence westerly and southerly along the contour line to its intersection with Frosst Creek

steps.until: its intersection with the 400 m contour line
steps.quote: thence southerly and easterly up Frosst Creek to its intersection with the 400 m contour line

steps.until: its intersection with the Department of National Defence's Military Reserve boundary
steps.quote: thence westerly, northerly and easterly along the 400 m contour line to its intersection with the Department of National Defence's Military Reserve boundary

steps.feature: Department of National Defence's Military Reserve
steps.until: its intersection with the Soowahlie Indian Reserve boundary
steps.quote: thence northerly and westerly along the Military Reserve boundary to its intersection with the Soowahlie Indian Reserve boundary

steps.until: its point of intersection with the southerly boundary of the District of Chilliwack
steps.quote: thence westerly and northerly along the Indian Reserve boundary to its point of intersection with the southerly boundary of the District of Chilliwack
thence westerly to the point of commencement

quotes.quote: Commencing at the intersection of the 250 m contour line
